themes.title: Nvidia CEO Huang ousted; board picks interim CFO
themes.summary: With Jensen Huang gone after misconduct and suspected-spy allegations, CFO Colette Kress now runs Nvidia on an interim basis and faces Tuesday earnings plus possible lawsuits and a succession search. The episode is a governance shock for the world's most valuable AI supplier.
themes.angle: A concentrated-founder company hits its first true test of institutional resilience.

themes.title: Anthropic IPO roadshow launches, S-1 filed
themes.summary: Anthropic filed its S-1 and began its IPO roadshow, a deal Bloomberg says is heavily oversubscribed and positioned to follow SpaceX's blockbuster debut as the next big AI listing. Jailed FTX founder SBF would have netted ~$40bn on his early stake.
themes.angle: After SpaceX, Anthropic is the second pillar testing how much public capital AI can absorb.

themes.title: US AI trust crisis as Democrats take Congress
themes.summary: Axios frames four colliding crises for AI titans with a Democratic surge and voter rebellion over data centers, making self-policing untenable and guardrails a new-Congress priority. Tech giants also face rising grid-cost pressure and Meta drew an EUR805m Italian fine over photo access.
themes.angle: The political wind in AI shifts from laissez-faire to accountability in one election.

themes.title: UAE courts agentic AI; Altman lauds adoption
themes.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman calls the UAE the world's most forward-looking country on AI adoption, landing as the UAE central bank primes 2027 rules around financial stability and cybersecurity. Startup AIREV raised Singapore capital to scale agentic AI in finance and healthcare.
themes.angle: UAE converts sovereign ambition into a regional agentic-AI and regulatory beachhead.

themes.title: Saudi AI: models, AGI-era infra, AI workforce
themes.summary: Saudi Arabia claims third place globally in AI model development and is advancing computing infrastructure and governance ahead of what it calls the AGI era, while enterprise adoption shows scale - Shaffra reports 800,000 work hours saved via AI employees and cybersecurity firm COGNNA took Wa'ed funding.
themes.angle: Saudi turns AI into sovereign capability metrics: rankings, compute, and hours saved.

themes.title: India backs native AI to avoid 'digital colony'
themes.summary: India is pinning hopes on government-backed startup Sarvam to build native models and escape technological dependence on US/China, per FT, even as Indian equities rebound once the global AI trade unwinds and foreign funds return.
themes.angle: National AI sovereignty is the new industrial policy - and India is a live case.
